reason: I need new volume and my two or three salespeople only farm existing accounts, so the 15-company sample costs me nothing and a 900 EUR cap with free no-shows is a number I can sign off myself. I'd do the free step first and only start the pilot if those 15 companies look like real buyers to me.
objection: If they send clumsy cold emails to companies in my own market, my name takes the hit, not theirs, and one GDPR complaint costs more than the whole pilot. Also 'one logistics client got 45 meetings' is one anecdote with no name, no cost per meeting and no word on how many turned into quotes.
